[![lifecycle](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#experimental)


[storethat](https://dev.bautheac.net/storethat/) is one of the workhorses for data ETL (extract, transform, load) work in the [finRes](https://dev.bautheac.net/finRes/) suite where it plays the important role of providing an off-Bloomberg storage facility for financial data retrieved from Bloomberg using the [pullit](https://dev.bautheac.net/pullit/) package. [storethat](https://dev.bautheac.net/storethat/) and [pullit](https://dev.bautheac.net/pullit/) work in conjunction with the [BBGsymbols](https://dev.bautheac.net/BBGsymbols/) package that provides carefully selected Bloomberg datafields for [pullit](https://dev.bautheac.net/pullit/) to query data for and for [storethat](https://dev.bautheac.net/storethat/) to store the corresponding retrieved data. Both packages are flexible to [BBGsymbols](https://dev.bautheac.net/BBGsymbols/) content dynamics in that enhancing [BBGsymbols](https://dev.bautheac.net/BBGsymbols/) with new datafield(s) won't alter data queries in [pullit](https://dev.bautheac.net/pullit/) nor [storethat](https://dev.bautheac.net/storethat/) storage facilities with any existing database eventually upgrading for the new field(s) on first encounter.  
Install the development version with `devtools::install_github("bautheac/storethat")`.
